title: Narumi's Week at Work - Day 1: The Platoon Leaders' Real Feelings
overview: Narumi skips out on a meeting to go to a restaurant, only to find out what his men really think of him.

title: Narumi's Week at Work - Day 2: The Vice-Captain's Troubles
overview: Vice-Captain Hasegawa struggles to find his successor, who will have to deal with Narumi's antics.

title: Narumi's Week at Work - Day 3: That Person From the West
overview: Narumi is visited by Soichiro, Hoshina's brother and the most powerful fighter in western Japan.
